_comment: CH9 (spec-v2/09-reliability-testing.md): quarantine for tests that fail on an unchanged tree. Each entry names the test, the tracked issue, and the wave that replaces it. The flake job reports these; it does not re-run them. Geometry and synthetic-beforeinput assertions belong to Wave 0 (conformance), not in-place jsdom stabilization.
